capabilityGroups.name: Coediting.OptimisticConflictDetection
capabilityGroups.notes: Native callbacks advance sceneRevision; batches with expectedRevision abort as EDIT_CONFLICT when human edits intervene.

capabilityGroups.name: Selection.Assets
capabilityGroups.notes: Asset Window objects are inspectable; the public API has no independent asset-selection setter.

capabilityGroups.name: Transform.Toggle2_5D
capabilityGroups.notes: Cavalry 2.7.2 documents has3dTransforms() but no public enable/disable operation.

capabilityGroups.name: ControlCentre.ListDescribe
capabilityGroups.notes: The public API exposes add/remove only; the tools return a specific unsupported error.

capabilityGroups.name: Beat.SyncUtilities
capabilityGroups.notes: Use beat_get_nth plus batch keyframe/layer operations; there is no distinct Cavalry sync API.

capabilityGroups.name: Preferences.EnumerateKnown
capabilityGroups.notes: Cavalry exposes keyed get/set but not enumeration of Preferences.json keys.

capabilityGroups.name: Viewport.SetTool
capabilityGroups.notes: No documented setActiveTool API and no UI driver is shipped yet.

capabilityGroups.name: Viewport.QAProfiles
capabilityGroups.notes: Profiles take explicit version-appropriate preference settings and always return the prior values for restoration.

capabilityGroups.name: Color.WorkingAndViewportSpaces
capabilityGroups.notes: Available only when exposed by current composition/preferences definitions.

capabilityGroups.name: Render.StatusAndWait
capabilityGroups.notes: No documented Cavalry 2.7.2 active-render status query exists, so reliable wait cannot be implemented.

capabilityGroups.name: Render.FormatsAndCodecs
capabilityGroups.notes: Installed render generators and codec attributes are discovered and set generically.

capabilityGroups.name: NativeDialogs
capabilityGroups.notes: Blocking native dialogs are deliberately not exposed for unattended automation.

capabilityGroups.name: UI.CommandSearch
capabilityGroups.notes: No accessibility driver is currently implemented; do not claim UI fallback coverage.

capabilityGroups.name: UI.Shortcuts
capabilityGroups.notes: No accessibility driver is currently implemented; do not claim UI fallback coverage.

capabilityGroups.name: UI.VisionFallback
capabilityGroups.notes: No verified vision interaction driver is currently implemented.

capabilityGroups.name: Presets
capabilityGroups.notes: Preset application is not exposed in the documented API and no UI driver is shipped.

capabilityGroups.name: Tags
capabilityGroups.notes: Experimental Tag controls have no documented structured API and no UI driver is shipped.

capabilityGroups.name: WorkspacesAndWindows
capabilityGroups.notes: Editor-only operations require a future accessibility driver.

capabilityGroups.name: ThirdParty.SceneNodes
capabilityGroups.notes: Dynamic type, attribute, generator, and connection inspection covers plugin scene nodes.

capabilityGroups.name: ThirdParty.CustomUI
capabilityGroups.notes: Custom plugin UI outside node attributes requires a future accessibility driver.

capabilityGroups.name: RawScript.EscapeHatch
capabilityGroups.notes: Disabled by default and requires CAVALRY_ALLOW_RAW_SCRIPT=true.

Scene Window.notes: Hierarchy, selection, visibility, stack order, and generic nodes are covered.

Time Editor.notes: Timeline, keyframes, markers, and key selection are covered.

Graph Editor.notes: Key tangents/velocity and Graph attribute presets are covered; editor layout is not.

Viewport.notes: Capture and active-tool reads are covered; UI-only display profiles are not.

Attribute Editor.notes: Discovery, values, limits, expressions, and selection are covered.

Dependency Graph.notes: Connections and generic node inspection are covered.

Assets.notes: Files, groups, sequences, cloud sheets, smart folders, ICC data, and async callbacks are covered.

Control Centre.notes: Add/remove are structured; listing/description have no public API.

Render Manager.notes: Queue basics are structured; format-specific attributes vary by installed definitions.

Tags.notes: No documented structured API and no accessibility fallback yet.

Presets.notes: No documented structured API and no accessibility fallback yet.

Tool Settings.notes: Scene-backed settings use attributes; editor-only settings remain unavailable.

Camera.notes: Planar cameras and Camera Guides are covered; 2.5D activation is not exposed.

Third-party plugins.notes: Scene-node attributes are generic; custom plugin UI remains unavailable.
